title: xiaomi miui 10.2 lockscreen
symptom: On all Xiaomi devices with MIUI 10.2, xDrip notifications do not show on the lockscreen.
cause: The issue is likely due to MIUI's lock screen notification settings hiding sensitive notifications, or notifications for xDrip being turned off.
fix: Change lock screen notification settings to 'Show all notifications' and ensure xDrip notifications are enabled. For the widget issue, use the notification on the lock screen as a workaround.
evidence_quote: If Lock screen is set to "Hide sensitive notifications only", change that to "Show all notifications". You should now be able to properly access the xDrip notification from your lockscreen.
